title: ProToM: Promoting Prosocial Behaviour via Theory of Mind-Informed Feedback
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing an AI facilitator to promote prosocial behavior (actions that benefit others) in multi-agent environments. While it mentions 'social good' and 'responsible AI' in the introduction, the core contribution is a technical method (ProToM) evaluated on task efficiency and success rate rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious beliefs.
